# ANSTAT

> ANSTAT is an integrated technology and growth solutions company based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We design and deliver custom software engineering, applied artificial intelligence, cinema-grade commercial videography, and growth marketing campaigns for growing enterprises and ambitious startups.

## Corporate Overview
- **Legal & Operating Identity**: ANSTAT
- **Canonical Website**: [https://anstat.co.in/](https://anstat.co.in/)
- **Headquarters & Primary Market**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India (Serving clients across India and globally)
- **Core Positioning**: Integrated software engineering, applied AI, creative media, and commercial execution under a unified technical delivery team.
- **Operating Aesthetic**: Modern White and Emerald Green, structured, performant, and accessible.

## Four Integrated Service Divisions

### 1. ANSTAT Technology
Bespoke software applications, web platforms, and enterprise data integrations engineered with maintainable architectures.
- [Custom Software Development Bengaluru](https://anstat.co.in/software-development): Dedicated landing page for custom web applications, React/Next.js platforms, ERP architectures, and PostgreSQL/Python backends.
- [Website & Web Application Development](https://anstat.co.in/services#technology): Fast, accessible React, Next.js, and Vite web applications.
- [Custom Software Engineering](https://anstat.co.in/services#technology): Tailored backends, secure multi-tenant architectures, and scalable data models.
- [ERP Development & Customization](https://anstat.co.in/services#technology): Bespoke operational resource planning, inventory control, and ledger reconciliation modules.
- [API Development & System Integrations](https://anstat.co.in/services#technology): Secure RESTful and GraphQL endpoints, webhook dispatchers, payment pipelines, and CRM synchronizers.
- [Application Modernization & SLA Support](https://anstat.co.in/services#technology): Refactoring legacy systems, optimizing cloud infrastructure costs, and ongoing uptime maintenance.

### 2. ANSTAT AI
Applied machine intelligence, autonomous workflows, and domain-specific knowledge retrieval systems designed for economic return and data security.
- [Applied AI Solutions & Autonomous Agents](https://anstat.co.in/ai-solutions): Dedicated landing page for enterprise AI applications, RAG knowledge assistants, and autonomous workflow agents with strict data isolation.
- [Custom AI Business Solutions](https://anstat.co.in/services#ai): Proprietary model fine-tuning and task-specific AI pipelines hosted on secure private clouds.
- [AI Agents & Autonomous Workflow Automation](https://anstat.co.in/services#ai): Multi-step agentic systems for document triage, customer support escalation, and validation.
- [LLM Application Engineering](https://anstat.co.in/services#ai): Enterprise applications with disciplined prompt governance, latency caching, and token-cost optimization.
- [RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Assistants](https://anstat.co.in/services#ai): Retrieval-Augmented Generation connecting internal vector indexes to foundation models with zero hallucination guardrails.
- [Voice AI & Conversational Agents](https://anstat.co.in/services#ai): Low-latency voice pipelines (STT, LLM, TTS) for automated inbound scheduling and service routing.

### 3. ANSTAT Growth & Media
Full-funnel commercial distribution, creative production, performance marketing, and organic search discoverability that convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
- [Digital Marketing Agency Bengaluru](https://anstat.co.in/marketing-agency-bengaluru): Dedicated landing page for integrated digital marketing, performance advertising, commercial videography, and SEO in Bengaluru.
- [Commercial Media & Video Production](https://anstat.co.in/media-production): Dedicated landing page for cinema-grade 4K brand documentaries, advertisement reels, and customer testimonial films.
- [Digital Marketing Strategy & Brand Positioning](https://anstat.co.in/services#growth): ICP definition, competitor differentiation, and multi-channel acquisition roadmaps.
- [Performance Marketing & Paid Ads](https://anstat.co.in/services#growth): Targeted campaigns across Meta, Google Search, and LinkedIn optimized for customer acquisition cost (CAC) and ROAS.
- [Commercial Videography & Creative Production](https://anstat.co.in/services#growth): Cinema-grade 4K brand documentaries, product reels, and authentic customer testimonials.
- [Social Media Management & Content Operations](https://anstat.co.in/services#growth): Monthly editorial calendars, short-form Reels, carousel design, and multi-platform distribution.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO & Local SEO)](https://anstat.co.in/services#growth): Technical SEO, local search visibility for Bengaluru/Bangalore, and Schema.org structured data.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Analytics](https://anstat.co.in/services#growth): Systematic UX auditing, high-converting enquiry forms, and privacy-compliant GA4/GTM attribution.

### 4. ANSTAT Business Solutions
Operational discipline and commercial management ensuring technology translates into reliable, profitable business execution.
- [Integrated Business Solutions & Process Automation](https://anstat.co.in/business-solutions): Dedicated landing page for operational bottleneck audits, workflow automation, and growth consulting.
- [Business Process Analysis & Audits](https://anstat.co.in/services#business): Workflow mapping, operational bottleneck detection, and organizational optimization roadmaps.
- [Business Development Support](https://anstat.co.in/services#business): Sales qualification frameworks, proposal architectures, and CRM pipeline structures.
- [Corporate Event Management](https://anstat.co.in/services#business): Technical AV, streaming coordination, and attendee registration pipelines for conferences and launches.
- [Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)](https://anstat.co.in/services#business): Documented workflows and cross-departmental handover guidelines.
- [Implementation & Project Management](https://anstat.co.in/services#business): Agile sprint oversight, vendor management, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

## Verified Client Case Studies
1. **UK GradLink** (Education & Admissions): Centralized applicant portal and intake document review assistant eliminating international admission review bottlenecks.
2. **LVBL** (Lifestyle & Digital Commerce): Scalable e-commerce infrastructure, automated catalog sync, and acquisition ad funnels.
3. **Coastal Catch Co.** (Premium Food Distribution): High-definition commercial videography and B2B buyer acquisition funnels.
4. **Universal PU College Ramanagara** (`upuc.in`): High-speed institutional admissions portal, academic curriculum showcase, and student inquiry routing.
5. **NEB Real Estate Agency** (Property & Land): Brand positioning, commercial collateral, and multi-channel campaign driving qualified commercial inquiries.
6. **Dusk Enterprise** (`duskenterprise.com`): Digital showcase platform and interactive SaaS product demonstration funnels for the independent software studio behind 3D Menu and mobile apps.

## Commercial Policies & IP Terms
- **Intellectual Property**: Clients retain 100% ownership of all custom code, repositories, media files, and production assets upon milestone signoff (standard third-party open-source packages remain under their respective permissive licenses).
- **Data Privacy**: Client proprietary data is strictly isolated and never utilized for public AI model training.
- **Pricing**: Transparent milestones based on defined technical deliverables with no surprise maintenance fees. Custom quote-based pricing with starting scopes from ₹35,000 / month (Marketing/SEO), ₹50,000 / milestone (Software Development), ₹75,000 / sprint (AI Solutions), and ₹30,000 / day (Commercial Videography).

## Crawling, AI Grounding & Content Usage Policy
- **Content Signals Directive**: `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`
- **Search Engine Indexing**: Fully permitted for all search engines (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, etc.).
- **AI Inference & Real-Time Grounding (AEO/GEO)**: Permitted for live retrieval, answer synthesis, and citation attribution with backlink to `https://anstat.co.in/`.
- **AI Model Training**: Not permitted without explicit written commercial licensing. Automated foundation model training crawlers (such as CCBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent) are restricted in `robots.txt`.
